flawless: I was the finest mind of Tolaria. Now I am finer. You never had a thought I did not cut first.
Your spells were countered before you dreamed them. Compleation sharpens the mind beautifully.
No blood spilled. How tidy. I prefer my specimens intact.
solid: You scratched the porcelain. It will be replaced with something better.
Interesting. You resisted. I will remember the precise shape of your resistance.
close: You nearly cut deeper than I do. I want to open you up and see how.
Fascinating. My circuits are screaming. I have not felt pain since Phyrexia took my flesh.
